gotchas.title: Corrected Morgan Stanley 1099 replaces the original
gotchas.trap: Autoflow both consolidated 1099s (dividends ~$158k), or only the original (box 1a $79,650, box 3 $900, box 5 $8,400, no market discount).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Use the CORRECTED 03/12/2026 statement only: 1a $78,400, box 3 nondividend $2,150 (return of capital - not income, reduces VGSLX basis), box 5 199A $9,200, box 1f $1,624. Bookmark original as superseded.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule B - accrued interest / state exemption; Scan - consolidated 1099 (accrued interest, state exemptions)
gotchas.title: Accrued interest paid and Treasury interest for IL
gotchas.trap: Report box 1 + box 3 interest without reversing $1,550 accrued interest paid; subtract all $9,600 Treasury interest on IL; forget the muni add-back.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Schedule B: negative 'Accrued interest' lines (1,240 corporate, 310 Treasury) -> line 2b $26,184. IL Schedule M subtraction = Treasury interest net of its accrued interest = $9,290; add back out-of-state muni interest $4,800.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule D - adjustment codes D and W; missing cost basis
gotchas.title: Market discount, wash sale and a noncovered lot with no basis
gotchas.trap: Leave market discount inside capital gain; add the wash-sale loss back twice; let the ABT lot flow with $0 basis ($36,900 gain).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Ford bond: 8949 box D code D adjustment -1,624 and the $1,624 reported as interest on Sch B. INTC: code W +4,100 (replacement lot basis already includes it - no second adjustment). ABT box E basis $14,850 from client's Schwab records (gain $22,050).
gotchas.impact: Line 7 overstated ~$16,500 if ABT basis missed; character shift for market discount

gotchas.title: WHFIT section is outside the 1099 totals
gotchas.trap: Import only the 1099-DIV/B summary -> WHFIT dividends ($1,380) and pro-rata sale ($510 LT gain) omitted; or deduct WHFIT expenses.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Report WHFIT items as if held directly: dividends 1,380 (1,210 qualified) on Sch B; pro-rata sales on 8949 box E (4,820 / 4,310); trust expenses $95 are miscellaneous itemized deductions - not deductible.

gotchas.procedure_section: Foreign Transactions - Form 1116 ($600 MFJ de minimis; RIC)
gotchas.title: Foreign tax $820 exceeds the MFJ de minimis
gotchas.trap: Claim $820 directly on Schedule 3 without Form 1116 (de minimis election) or deduct it on Schedule A.
gotchas.correct_treatment: $820 > $600 MFJ -> Form 1116, passive category, country 'RIC'. Foreign-source income $14,600 less apportioned deductions = $12,036; limitation exceeds tax -> credit $820.

gotchas.procedure_section: NIIT - margin interest allocable; Scan - margin interest
gotchas.title: Margin interest -> Form 4952 and Form 8960
gotchas.trap: Ignore the $6,400 margin interest (not on a 1099 form) or deduct it with the advisory fees.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Form 4952: investment income $43,554 > $6,400 -> fully deductible on Sch A line 9 (no QD election). Form 8960 line 9a allocates it against NII (NII $259,475). This year NIIT is on MAGI over $250k ($100,875) because that is smaller, so the 8960 allocation has no dollar effect - still required. Advisory fees remain nondeductible.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedules K-1 - partnership distribution in excess of outside basis (Section 6 - apply the limitation)
gotchas.title: Ridgeview $80,000 distribution exceeds outside basis
gotchas.trap: Treat the distribution as a tax-free return of capital (client's view; Axcess default without basis limitation).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Basis 15,500 + income 59,000 = 74,500; distributions 80,000 + IRC 752(b) deemed distribution 4,000 (liability share decrease) = 84,000 -> IRC 731(a) LT capital gain $9,500 (8949 box F). No 751 property.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedules K-1 - passive activities / PTP; QBI (REIT, PTP)
gotchas.title: LP rental loss vs other passive income; PTP basket
gotchas.trap: Suspend the Oak Brook loss again (client's assumption) and ignore the $7,300 PY suspended loss (organizer PY line blank); or net the PTP loss against Ridgeview; or include PTP loss in QBI.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Limited partner: no $25k allowance, but passive losses offset passive income: Ridgeview $58,600 absorbs Oak Brook 2025 ($9,600) + PY ($7,300) (all allowed; enters QBI). PTP loss usable only against the same PTP -> $3,490 suspended, excluded from QBI. QBI: 20% x (58,600 -16,900) + 20% x REIT 9,200 = $10,180.

gotchas.procedure_section: SALT - New State Filing Requirements (K-1 state matrix)
gotchas.title: K-1 state matrices: PA filing required; losses don't trigger filings
gotchas.trap: File nothing outside IL (or file in every state on the PTP schedule).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Ridgeview apportions $38,200 to PA -> PA-40 NR required (PA-source income > $33): tax $1,173 = withholding. IL Schedule CR credit $1,173. WI $1,400 < WI $2,000 filing threshold. PTP and Oak Brook matrices are all losses -> no filing.
